test_objective: Verify endpoint p95 latency remains <= 450ms under concurrent load (Benchmark Scenario #1).
preconditions: Database populated with 10,000 employee records and 50,000 attendance rows
test_steps: 1. Execute k6 load test ramping from 1 to 50 concurrent virtual users
2. Measure request rate, error rate, and response latency percentiles
expected_results: p95 response time <= 450 ms; error rate < 0.01% under nominal workload.
